_meta.title: FactoryBench: Evaluating Industrial Machine Understanding (arxiv 2605.07675)
_meta.context: FactoryBench is a new industrial-robotics benchmark from ETH Zurich + Forgis + UC3M + Imperial + UC Berkeley + KTH + University of Vienna (Merzouki et al, May 8 2026). Evaluates LLMs on machine-behavior reasoning over multivariate robot telemetry (UR3 cobot + KUKA KR10 industrial arm). Four-level causal hierarchy per Pearl's ladder: L1 State (N=1,209) / L2 Intervention (N=3,132) / L3 Counterfactual (N=297) / L4 Decision (N=113). Companion dataset FactoryWave (8,983 episodes at 125/83 Hz, 27 fault types, 3 tasks: pick-and-place, peg-in-hole, screwdriving). 6 frontier LLMs evaluated zero-shot (April 2026 submission cohort).
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION — all values verbatim from PDF Figure 3a 'FactoryBench Results: Model × Level (Chance-Corrected)'. Metric is chance-corrected accuracy (%) — paper explicitly chance-corrects per level. Simple Baseline row (no-LLM linear regression + uniform random) omitted as it's not a frontier model. L4 'Simple Baseline' cell is blank in figure (paper notes 'free-form Level 4 templates are excluded from the baseline').

benchmarks.name: FactoryBench L1 — State
benchmarks.description: FactoryBench Level 1 (State): interpret current operational state of an industrial robot from raw multivariate telemetry. N=1,209 Q&A items. Probes basic temporal feature extraction. Chance-corrected accuracy (%). arxiv 2605.07675.

benchmarks.name: FactoryBench L2 — Intervention
benchmarks.description: FactoryBench Level 2 (Intervention): reason about consequences of present-timestep interventions/events on machine states. N=3,132 Q&A items. Targets fault diagnosis and control-action impact prediction. Chance-corrected accuracy (%). arxiv 2605.07675.

benchmarks.name: FactoryBench L3 — Counterfactual
benchmarks.description: FactoryBench Level 3 (Counterfactual): simulate alternative histories — what would have happened under different past interventions. N=297 Q&A items (ground truth via expensive physical re-execution). Pearl's ladder rung 3. Chance-corrected accuracy (%). arxiv 2605.07675.

benchmarks.name: FactoryBench L4 — Decision Making
benchmarks.description: FactoryBench Level 4 (Decision Making): given recorded episode + task, produce recommended sequence of corrective actions grounded in manufacturer recovery protocols. N=113 free-form items, scored by median of 3 LLM judges. Most LLMs fail catastrophically (4.3-17.7%); GPT-5.1 leads at 17.7%. arxiv 2605.07675.

scores._note: L1 SOTA on FactoryBench. PDF Figure 3a.
Fails to beat simple baseline (28.4%) by meaningful margin — paper highlights this as surprising for the largest model in panel.
Lightweight open-weight reference point. Below baseline.
Notably strong on counterfactual reasoning relative to L1 — narrows gap with Sonnet 4.6.

scores._section: === L4 Decision Making (N=113) — all models collapse below 18% ===
scores._note: Only model with meaningful decision-making signal. Far ahead of pack (next is DeepSeek V3.2 at 7.6%). Paper sub-breakdown: L4.1 Troubleshooting 17.4%, L4.2 Optimization 20.1%.
L1-L3 SOTA but L4 collapse — 10x drop. Largest L3→L4 gap in panel.
